title: Augmented anomaly scorer + console notifier playbook for usage/cost/latency
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a production-grade backend scorer and notifier that ingests existing usage, cost, and latency telemetry and emits contextualized anomaly events for Console alerts. The goal is not just binary anomaly flags but an 'augmented' signal: a probabilistic score, top contributing features, and enrichment metadata (deployment id, model variant, customer tier, recent infra changes). These enriched events will power Console notifications, prioritized incident channels, and automated suppression heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: A streaming job writes standardized anomaly events to 'anomaly-events-v2' topic with schema v1.2
Console receives and displays enriched anomaly cards with score, explanation, and suggested severity
On-call playbook actions are surfaced with one-click links to traces, recent deploys, and cost dashboards
False positive rate on a held-out set is <= 8% for P0-class alerts and precision/recall meets thresholds in eval doc
Backfill path exists to retro-compute scores for 30 days of telemetry without breaking production cluster
technical_notes: Signal fusion: combine change-point detectors (EWMA + Bayesian online changepoint), distributional shift tests, and a lightweight classifier trained on historical incidents
Feature windowing: keep both short (1-5m) and medium (1-2h) windows; compute relative percentiles per-tenant to account for skew
Probabilistic score: output 0-1 with calibrated reliability; store calibration metadata to allow threshold tuning per-customer tier
Enrichment sources: deployments (CI event stream), infra tagging (region/GPUs), billing tier, recent routing/fallback events from Smart Router
Pipeline tech: Apache Beam job reading from metrics topic, writing anomalies to Kafka; downstream consumer (go-service) persists to anomalies DB and triggers Console webhook
Backfill approach: run batch Beam job over daily metrics partitions; use downsampling to limit cost; provide dry-run mode to compare new vs existing alerts

Cost/perf tradeoff: more complex models reduce FP but increase CPU on streaming path. Default rollout will start with light-weight statistical detectors + optional classifier enrichment in best-effort mode
Schema: include fields event_id, scored_at, score, contributing_features (top3), explain_text, tenant_id, model_hint, ingestion_lag_ms, backfill_flag
timeline: Phase 1 (2 weeks): schema + lightweight detectors + Console rendering prototype. Phase 2 (3 weeks): enrichment joins, calibration, and backfill tooling. Phase 3 (2 weeks): canary rollout to internal tenants and ops team, iterate on suppression rules. Target GA path by end of Cycle 43.
